key_facts: LiteLLM 1.107.0 wheels (all platforms) + Docker tags carried malware for 1h45m (PyPI) / 2h35m (Docker)
Attacker used 3 stolen maintainer GitHub CLI credentials, bypassed branch protection, built from a lookalike repo
cook.pth/cook.py stealer harvests SSH keys, cloud creds, CI secrets, LLM provider keys, encrypts with AES-256+RSA-4096, exfils to litellm[.]dev
sitecustomize.py backdoor polls a GitHub file hourly for a C2 address and runs second-stage code
C2 lookup account now 404s, but hosts that ran the daemon before removal may have executed second-stage code -- rotate credentials
